# Measured weights for the macOS coreutils corpus shards, in seconds.
#
# `TestName seconds` per line; `#` comments and blanks ignored. A name with no
# entry weighs 1, so this file steers BALANCE only: scripts/shard-tests
# partitions the live `go test -list` output of the macOS runner itself, and
# every listed name lands in exactly one bucket. A stale weight costs an
# unevenly filled shard, nothing more.
#
# Separate from coreutils-test-weights.txt because Darwin's costs are not
# Linux's: TestPrintfParity is 169 s there and 37 s here, TestMulticallParity
# 96 s there and 201 s here.
#
# Entries under 2 s are omitted. Source: the per-test times in the
# coreutils-corpus-darwin log of run 35733713188 (2026-09-22). Refresh from the
# shard logs when the two macOS shards drift apart.
